subject: Initial onboarding: admin invites, API key seeding & KMS question
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>

Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 12 Apr 2025 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Initial onboarding: admin invites, API key seeding & KMS question

Hi Olivia — great to meet you (virtually).

Thanks for signing with Redwood. To make the first week smooth we typically do a short kickoff + an invite/key seeding cadence so your engineers can hit the ground running. Attached are a lightweight onboarding-checklist and the SOW (SOW-v3) for reference.

High-level proposal:
- Day 0 (kickoff): 30–45m call to align scope and access owners.
- Day 1: Create org/project, seed a single admin service key for your SRE lead (expiring 90 days).
- Day 3: Seed dev keys + invite regular users (scoped roles).
- Day 7: Short follow-up to confirm telemetry and alerting.

Two quick questions for ClearMed so we can finalize the plan:
1) Do you plan to manage production API keys via your KMS/HSM (we support AWS KMS, GCP KMS, and customer HSM keys), or do you want Redwood-managed keys initially?
2) Who should receive the initial admin invite (name + email + role)?

Notes on security and rotation: when you opt for KMS we’ll wire the key material to your KMS alias and Redwood will not persist plaintext keys. If you want, Dev can prepare a seed script that creates the project and seeds the initial service role.

Proposed kickoff windows next week: Mon 4/14 10:00–11:00 PT or Tue 4/15 13:00–14:00 PT — which works?

Attachments: onboarding-checklist.pdf, SOW-v3.pdf

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0138

Thanks Naomi — excited to get started. Quick answers below and a couple of clarifications.

We do intend to use our AWS KMS for production keys long-term, but for the initial integration we can accept Redwood-managed keys for the staging workspace. For production we'd like KMS integration before we flip traffic.

Initial admin invite:
- Samir Gupta <sgupta@clearmed.com> (DevOps Lead)
- Olivia Chen <olivia@clearmed.com> (Product Lead)

Seed script is great — can Dev include a step that also creates a non-prod project and a hook to route logs to our Splunk instance? We’ll provide the Splunk endpoint on the kickoff call.

Kickoff: Mon 4/14 10:00 PT works for us. Can you send a calendar invite?

Thanks,
Olivia

Subject: Re: Initial onboarding: admin invites, API key seeding & KMS question

Perfect — thanks for confirming. Quick responses to the items below.

1) KMS: we’ll do Redwood-managed keys for the staging project now. For production, we’ll perform the KMS handshake (we’ll need an AWS KMS key alias + an IAM role ARN that Redwood can assume). I’ve attached our KMS-integration-guide with the minimal IAM policy.

2) Seed script: Dev will include non-prod project creation, initial admin user seed, and a Splunk forwarder hook. The seed will create:
   - org: clearmed-prod (locked until you approve)
   - project: clearmed-nonprod (staging)
   - service-account: clearmed-seed-admin (scoped: admin)

Rotation plan we recommend: initial seed key TTL = 90 days; set up automated rotation on day 60 to create a replacement key and notify ClearMed SRE.

Next steps I’ll take before Monday’s kickoff:
- Send calendar invite for Mon 4/14 10:00 PT (Ben will own scheduling).
- Dev to prep seed-script.sh and a short readme for the Splunk hook (attached).
- Send DocuSign for SOW-v3 so legal can sign (link below).

DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/notice/ABC12345
Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Onboarding/ClearMed

Cheers,
Naomi
